adaptations: Validates the API key via GET /api/v1/validate.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the configured Datadog API key against the US1 API.

monitors.list.title: List Monitors
monitors.list.description: List Datadog monitors with bounded optional filters.

pageSize.description: Page size, capped at 100 by Datadog.

monitors.get.title: Get Monitor
monitors.get.description: Retrieve one Datadog monitor by numeric ID.

groupStates.description: Comma-separated group states: all, alert, warn, or no data.

metrics.list.title: List Metrics
metrics.list.description: List Datadog metrics active since a Unix timestamp.

monitors.create.title: Create Monitor
monitors.create.description: Create a Datadog monitor from a type, query, and optional name and message.

type.description: Monitor type, for example metric alert.

options.description: Monitor options such as thresholds and renotify.

monitors.update.title: Update Monitor
monitors.update.description: Update a Datadog monitor query, name, or message by numeric ID.

type.description: Monitor type. Sent only when set.

monitors.delete.title: Delete Monitor
monitors.delete.description: Delete a Datadog monitor by numeric ID.

force.description: Force delete. Sent as the force query parameter.

monitors.mute.title: Mute Monitor
monitors.mute.description: Mute a Datadog monitor, optionally until a Unix end timestamp.

monitors.unmute.title: Unmute Monitor
monitors.unmute.description: Unmute a previously muted Datadog monitor.

metrics.query.title: Query Metrics
metrics.query.description: Query Datadog timeseries points between two Unix timestamps.

dashboards.list.title: List Dashboards
dashboards.list.description: List Datadog dashboards available to the authenticated account.

filterShared.description: Filter by shared status. Sent as filter[shared].

filterDeleted.description: Include deleted dashboards. Sent as filter[deleted].

dashboards.get.title: Get Dashboard
dashboards.get.description: Retrieve one Datadog dashboard by ID.

dashboards.create.title: Create Dashboard
dashboards.create.description: Create a Datadog dashboard with a title, layout type, and widgets.

dashboards.delete.title: Delete Dashboard
dashboards.delete.description: Delete a Datadog dashboard by ID.

events.list.title: List Events
events.list.description: List Datadog events that occurred after a Unix start timestamp.

events.get.title: Get Event
events.get.description: Retrieve one Datadog event by numeric ID.

events.create.title: Create Event
events.create.description: Post an event to the Datadog event stream.

alertType.description: Alert type such as info, warning, error, or success.

host.description: Host name associated with the event.

dateHappened.description: Unix timestamp when the event happened.

sourceTypeName.description: Source type name such as jenkins or docker.

currentOnly.description: When true, only currently active downtimes are returned.

downtimes.create.title: Create Downtime
downtimes.create.description: Schedule a Datadog downtime for one or more monitor scopes.

downtimes.cancel.title: Cancel Downtime
downtimes.cancel.description: Cancel a scheduled Datadog downtime by numeric ID.

hosts.list.title: List Hosts
hosts.list.description: List Datadog infrastructure hosts with an optional search filter.

sortField.description: status, name, cpu, iowait, or load.

incidents.list.title: List Incidents
incidents.list.description: List Datadog incidents with an optional page size.

filter.description: Incident search filter such as state:active.

logs.aggregate.title: Aggregate logs
logs.aggregate.description: Aggregate Datadog logs with POST /api/v2/logs/analytics/aggregate. Omit fields to use Datadog defaults (a total count). Composio: DATADOG_AGGREGATE_LOGS.

compute.description: Aggregation computes. Each item is a Datadog compute object.

filter.description: Log query, time range, indexes, and storage tier.

page.description: Cursor for an alphabetically sorted aggregate query.

logs.search.title: Search logs
logs.search.description: Search log events with POST /api/v2/logs/events/search. Datadog rejects a sort field on this endpoint, so it is not sent. timeFrom and timeTo are date-math or millisecond timestamp strings. Composio: DATADOG_SEARCH_LOGS.

timeFrom.description: Start time as date math or a millisecond timestamp string.

timeTo.description: End time as date math or a millisecond timestamp string.

indexes.description: Log index names. Omit to search the default indexes.

page.description: Pagination object with limit and cursor (Composio start_at).

logs.indexes.list.title: List log indexes
logs.indexes.list.description: List configured log indexes with GET /api/v1/logs/config/indexes. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_LOG_INDEXES.

metrics.scalar.title: Query scalar data
metrics.scalar.description: Run a formula scalar query with POST /api/v2/query/scalar. fromTimestamp and toTimestamp are Unix epoch milliseconds. Composio: DATADOG_QUERY_SCALAR_DATA.

fromTimestamp.description: Inclusive window start as Unix epoch milliseconds.

toTimestamp.description: Exclusive window end as Unix epoch milliseconds.

queries.description: Typed scalar queries selected by data_source.

metrics.timeseries.title: Query timeseries data
metrics.timeseries.description: Run a formula timeseries query with POST /api/v2/query/timeseries. Timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds. Composio: DATADOG_QUERY_TIMESERIES_DATA.

fromTimestamp.description: Inclusive window start as Unix epoch milliseconds.

toTimestamp.description: Exclusive window end as Unix epoch milliseconds.

queries.description: Typed timeseries queries selected by data_source.

metrics.submit.title: Submit metrics
metrics.submit.description: Submit custom metric series with POST /api/v2/series. Composio: DATADOG_SUBMIT_METRICS.

auditLogs.search.title: Search audit logs
auditLogs.search.description: Search Audit Trail events with POST /api/v2/audit/events/search. Composio: DATADOG_SEARCH_AUDIT_LOGS.

fromTime.description: Start time as date math or a millisecond timestamp string.

toTime.description: End time as date math or a millisecond timestamp string.

page.description: Pagination object with limit and cursor.

options.description: timezone or time_offset. Datadog treats them as mutually exclusive.

events.search.title: Search events
events.search.description: Search Event Management events with POST /api/v2/events/search. This is distinct from the v1 GET /api/v1/events list. Composio: DATADOG_SEARCH_EVENTS.

fromTime.description: Start time as date math or a millisecond timestamp string.

toTime.description: End time as date math or a millisecond timestamp string.

page.description: Pagination object with limit and cursor.

options.description: timezone or time_offset. Datadog treats them as mutually exclusive.

spans.aggregate.title: Search spans analytics
spans.aggregate.description: Aggregate span analytics with POST /api/v2/spans/analytics/aggregate. The body type is aggregate_request. Composio: DATADOG_SEARCH_SPANS_ANALYTICS.

filter.description: Span filter. Include query and a bounded from/to window.

traces.search.title: Search traces
traces.search.description: Search spans for distributed traces with POST /api/v2/spans/events/search. Composio: DATADOG_SEARCH_TRACES.

filter.description: Span search filter. Custom attributes need an @ prefix.

traces.get.title: Get trace by ID
traces.get.description: Fetch spans for one trace id with POST /api/v2/spans/events/search. Datadog does not publish a GET-by-id trace route; the public API is span search filtered by trace_id. Composio: DATADOG_GET_TRACE_BY_ID.

fromTime.description: Search window start as date math or a millisecond timestamp string.

toTime.description: Search window end as date math or a millisecond timestamp string.

dashboards.update.title: Update dashboard
dashboards.update.description: Replace a dashboard with PUT /api/v1/dashboard/{dashboardId}. title, widgets, and layoutType are required by the Datadog PUT body. Composio: DATADOG_UPDATE_DASHBOARD.

reflowType.description: auto or fixed. Sent only when set.

pauseAutoRefresh.description: Whether automatic refresh is paused. Sent only when set.

slos.create.title: Create SLO
slos.create.description: Create a service level objective with POST /api/v1/slo. Composio: DATADOG_CREATE_SLO.

query.description: Query for a metric SLO. numerator and denominator.

monitorIds.description: Monitor ids for a monitor SLO.

slos.list.title: List SLOs
slos.list.description: List service level objectives with GET /api/v1/slo. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_SL_OS.

query.description: Search query over name or description.

tags.description: Comma-separated tag filter sent as tags_query.

synthetics.apiTests.create.title: Create synthetic API test
synthetics.apiTests.create.description: Create an API synthetic test with POST /api/v1/synthetics/tests/api. The body type is api. Composio: DATADOG_CREATE_SYNTHETIC_API_TEST.

options.description: Execution options such as tick_every and locations.

subtype.description: http, ssl, tcp, dns, or icmp.

synthetics.tests.list.title: List synthetics tests
synthetics.tests.list.description: List synthetic tests with GET /api/v1/synthetics/tests. pageSize and pageNumber are the documented page_size and page_number query parameters. Tag and location filters are not parameters of this list route. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_SYNTHETICS.

pageNumber.description: Zero-based page number sent as page_number.

synthetics.locations.list.title: Get synthetics locations
synthetics.locations.list.description: List public and private synthetic locations with GET /api/v1/synthetics/locations. Composio: DATADOG_GET_SYNTHETICS_LOCATIONS.

webhooks.create.title: Create webhook
webhooks.create.description: Create a named webhook destination with POST /api/v1/integration/webhooks/configuration/webhooks. Monitors must reference the name to deliver alerts. Composio: DATADOG_CREATE_WEBHOOK.

customHeaders.description: Custom headers as a JSON object string.

webhooks.list.title: List webhooks
webhooks.list.description: List webhook destinations with GET /api/v1/integration/webhooks/configuration/webhooks. The public route returns the full set and has no limit query parameter. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_WEBHOOKS.

tags.list.title: List host tags
tags.list.description: List host tags in the organization with GET /api/v1/tags/hosts. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_ALL_TAGS.

source.description: Tag source such as users, chef, puppet, or datadog.

hosts.tags.get.title: Get host tags
hosts.tags.get.description: Get tags for one host with GET /api/v1/tags/hosts/{hostName}. Composio: DATADOG_GET_TAGS.

source.description: Tag source such as users, chef, or puppet.

hosts.tags.update.title: Update host tags
hosts.tags.update.description: Replace host tags from one source with PUT /api/v1/tags/hosts/{hostName}. Composio: DATADOG_UPDATE_HOST_TAGS.

tags.description: Tags that replace the existing tags for the source.

source.description: Tag source. Datadog defaults to users when omitted.

usage.summary.title: Get usage summary
usage.summary.description: Get billable usage summary with GET /api/v1/usage/summary. Months with no usage return an empty payload. Composio: DATADOG_GET_USAGE_SUMMARY.

endMonth.description: End month as YYYY-MM. Defaults to startMonth when omitted.

apiKeys.list.title: List API keys
apiKeys.list.description: List organization API keys with GET /api/v2/api_keys. Response metadata includes key names and owners. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_API_KEYS.

pageNumber.description: Zero-based page number sent as page[number].

filterCreatedAtStart.description: ISO timestamp. Keys created after this time.

filterCreatedAtEnd.description: ISO timestamp. Keys created before this time.

filterModifiedAtStart.description: ISO timestamp. Keys modified after this time.

filterModifiedAtEnd.description: ISO timestamp. Keys modified before this time.

apm.services.list.title: List APM services
apm.services.list.description: List APM services with GET /api/v2/apm/services. filter[env] is required by Datadog; pass * for every environment. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_APM_SERVICES.

env.description: Environment filter. Use * for all environments.

apm.serviceDependencies.get.title: Get service dependencies
apm.serviceDependencies.get.description: Get one APM service dependency map with GET /api/v1/service_dependencies/{service}. Composio: DATADOG_GET_SERVICE_DEPENDENCIES.

start.description: Window start as Unix epoch seconds.

end.description: Window end as Unix epoch seconds.

aws.accounts.list.title: List AWS integration accounts
aws.accounts.list.description: List AWS accounts integrated with Datadog with GET /api/v1/integration/aws. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_AWS_INTEGRATION.

roles.list.title: List roles
roles.list.description: List organization roles with GET /api/v2/roles. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_ROLES.

sort.description: Sort field such as name, created_at, or user_count.

pageNumber.description: Zero-based page number sent as page[number].

filterName.description: Partial role name sent as filter.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List organization users with GET /api/v2/users. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_USERS.

sort.description: Sort field such as name, email, status, or created_at.

pageNumber.description: Zero-based page number sent as page[number].

filterStatus.description: Active, Pending, or Disabled. Sent as filter.

oncall.escalationPolicies.create.title: Create escalation policy
oncall.escalationPolicies.create.description: Create an On-Call escalation policy with POST /api/v2/on-call/escalation-policies. Composio: DATADOG_CREATE_ESCALATION_POLICY.

data.description: JSON:API data object forwarded as the request body data field.

oncall.escalationPolicies.get.title: Get escalation policy
oncall.escalationPolicies.get.description: Get an On-Call escalation policy with GET /api/v2/on-call/escalation-policies/{policyId}. Composio: DATADOG_GET_ESCALATION_POLICY.

oncall.escalationPolicies.update.title: Update escalation policy
oncall.escalationPolicies.update.description: Replace an On-Call escalation policy with PUT /api/v2/on-call/escalation-policies/{policyId}. Composio: DATADOG_UPDATE_ESCALATION_POLICY.

data.description: JSON:API data object forwarded as the request body data field.

oncall.escalationPolicies.delete.title: Delete escalation policy
oncall.escalationPolicies.delete.description: Delete an On-Call escalation policy with DELETE /api/v2/on-call/escalation-policies/{policyId}. Composio: DATADOG_DELETE_ESCALATION_POLICY.

oncall.schedules.create.title: Create schedule
oncall.schedules.create.description: Create an On-Call schedule with POST /api/v2/on-call/schedules. Composio: DATADOG_CREATE_SCHEDULE.

data.description: JSON:API data object forwarded as the request body data field.

oncall.schedules.get.title: Get schedule
oncall.schedules.get.description: Get an On-Call schedule with GET /api/v2/on-call/schedules/{scheduleId}. Composio: DATADOG_GET_SCHEDULE.

oncall.schedules.update.title: Update schedule
oncall.schedules.update.description: Replace an On-Call schedule with PUT /api/v2/on-call/schedules/{scheduleId}. Composio: DATADOG_UPDATE_SCHEDULE.

data.description: JSON:API data object forwarded as the request body data field.

oncall.schedules.delete.title: Delete schedule
oncall.schedules.delete.description: Delete an On-Call schedule with DELETE /api/v2/on-call/schedules/{scheduleId}. Composio: DATADOG_DELETE_SCHEDULE.

oncall.schedules.onCall.title: Get scheduled on-call user
oncall.schedules.onCall.description: Get the user on call for a schedule with GET /api/v2/on-call/schedules/{scheduleId}/on-call. Datadog marks this route deprecated in favor of responders, and it remains the public call for this tool. Composio: DATADOG_GET_SCHEDULED_ON_CALL_USER.

oncall.notificationChannels.create.title: Create notification channel
oncall.notificationChannels.create.description: Create an On-Call notification channel with POST /api/v2/on-call/users/{userId}/notification-channels. Composio: DATADOG_CREATE_NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL.

data.description: JSON:API data object forwarded as the request body data field.

oncall.notificationChannels.list.title: List notification channels
oncall.notificationChannels.list.description: List On-Call notification channels for a user with GET /api/v2/on-call/users/{userId}/notification-channels. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_NOTIFICATION_CHANNELS.

oncall.notificationChannels.get.title: Get notification channel
oncall.notificationChannels.get.description: Get one On-Call notification channel with GET /api/v2/on-call/users/{userId}/notification-channels/{channelId}. Composio: DATADOG_GET_NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL.

oncall.notificationChannels.delete.title: Delete notification channel
oncall.notificationChannels.delete.description: Delete an On-Call notification channel with DELETE /api/v2/on-call/users/{userId}/notification-channels/{channelId}. Composio: DATADOG_DELETE_NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL.

oncall.notificationRules.create.title: Create notification rule
oncall.notificationRules.create.description: Create an On-Call notification rule with POST /api/v2/on-call/users/{userId}/notification-rules. Composio: DATADOG_CREATE_NOTIFICATION_RULE.

data.description: JSON:API data object forwarded as the request body data field.

oncall.notificationRules.list.title: List notification rules
oncall.notificationRules.list.description: List On-Call notification rules for a user with GET /api/v2/on-call/users/{userId}/notification-rules. Composio: DATADOG_LIST_NOTIFICATION_RULES.

oncall.notificationRules.get.title: Get notification rule
oncall.notificationRules.get.description: Get one On-Call notification rule with GET /api/v2/on-call/users/{userId}/notification-rules/{ruleId}. Composio: DATADOG_GET_NOTIFICATION_RULE.

oncall.notificationRules.update.title: Update notification rule
oncall.notificationRules.update.description: Replace an On-Call notification rule with PUT /api/v2/on-call/users/{userId}/notification-rules/{ruleId}. Composio: DATADOG_UPDATE_NOTIFICATION_RULE.

data.description: JSON:API data object forwarded as the request body data field.

oncall.notificationRules.delete.title: Delete notification rule
oncall.notificationRules.delete.description: Delete an On-Call notification rule with DELETE /api/v2/on-call/users/{userId}/notification-rules/{ruleId}. Composio: DATADOG_DELETE_NOTIFICATION_RULE.

oncall.teams.onCall.title: Get team on-call users
oncall.teams.onCall.description: Get the users currently on call for a team with GET /api/v2/on-call/teams/{teamId}/on-call. Composio: DATADOG_GET_TEAM_ON_CALL_USERS.

oncall.teams.routingRules.get.title: Get team routing rules
oncall.teams.routingRules.get.description: Get On-Call routing rules for a team with GET /api/v2/on-call/teams/{teamId}/routing-rules. Composio: DATADOG_GET_TEAM_ROUTING_RULES.

oncall.teams.routingRules.set.title: Set team routing rules
oncall.teams.routingRules.set.description: Replace On-Call routing rules for a team with PUT /api/v2/on-call/teams/{teamId}/routing-rules. Composio: DATADOG_SET_TEAM_ROUTING_RULES.
